# Building and contributing

Application build and development documentation lives in the
[Among Terminal repository](https://github.com/Among-Terminal/among).
Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Among-Terminal/among/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
to contribute, or follow the [build guide](https://github.com/Among-Terminal/among/blob/main/docs/build.md)
to build the application.

For ready-made packages, see [installation](/install/).
